G3124.name: Malchus
G3124.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3124.brief: High priest's servant whose ear was cut off by Peter.
G3124.short: Malchus, the high priest's servant, had his ear cut off by Peter during Jesus' arrest.

G3127.name: Manaen
G3127.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3127.brief: Prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch.
G3127.short: Manaen, a prophet and teacher, was part of the church at Antioch.

G3138.name: Mark
G3138.desc: Levite living at the time of the New Testament
G3138.brief: Cousin of Barnabas, companion of Paul, author of Gospel.
G3138.short: Mark (also called John), Barnabas' cousin and Paul's companion, was the author of the Gospel of Mark.

G3136.name: Martha
G3136.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G3136.brief: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus.
G3136.short: Martha, the sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus in her home.

G3137L.name: Mary
G3137L.desc: Barnabus' relative living at the time of the New Testament
G3137L.brief: Mother of John Mark; hosted prayer meeting.
G3137L.short: Mary, the mother of John Mark, hosted a prayer meeting in her house.

G3137J.name: Mary
G3137J.desc: Lazarus' sister living at the time of the New Testament
G3137J.brief: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet.
G3137J.short: Mary, the sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet and anointed Him with perfume.

G3137G.name: Mary
G3137G.desc: Jesus' mother living at the time of the New Testament
G3137G.brief: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.
G3137G.short: Mary, the mother of Jesus and wife of Joseph, was a virgin when she conceived by the Holy Spirit.

G3137K.name: Mary
G3137K.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G3137K.brief: Wife of Cleopas (or 'Alphaeus'), present at Jesus' crucifixion.
G3137K.short: Mary, the wife of Cleopas (or 'Alphaeus'), was present at Jesus' crucifixion.

G3137M.name: Mary
G3137M.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G3137M.brief: A woman who worked hard for the church in Rome.
G3137M.short: Mary was a woman who worked very hard for the church in Rome.

G3137I.name: Mary Magdalene
G3137I.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G3137I.brief: Follower of Jesus, first witness of His resurrection.
G3137I.short: Mary Magdalene, a follower of Jesus, was the first to witness His resurrection.

G3160.name: Mattatha
G3160.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
G3160.short: Mattatha was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in His genealogy.

G3161G.name: Mattathias
G3161G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G3161G.short: Mattathias was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in His genealogy.

G3161H.name: Mattathias
G3161H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G3161H.short: Mattathias was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in His genealogy.

G3157.name: Matthan
G3157.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G3157.brief: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
G3157.short: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

G3158G.name: Matthat
G3158G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G3158G.short: Matthat was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in His genealogy.

G3158H.name: Matthat
G3158H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G3158H.short: Matthat was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in His genealogy.

G3156.name: Matthew
G3156.desc: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G3156.brief: Apostle, tax collector, author of the Gospel of Matthew.
G3156.short: Matthew, also known as Levi, was a tax collector who became one of Jesus' twelve apostles and authored the Gospel of Matthew.

G3159.name: Matthias
G3159.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3159.brief: Apostle chosen to replace Judas Iscariot.
G3159.short: Matthias was chosen by lot to replace Judas Iscariot as one of the twelve apostles.

G3197G.name: Melchi
G3197G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G3197G.brief: An ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy.
G3197G.short: Melchi, mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus.

G3197H.name: Melchi
G3197H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G3197H.brief: An ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy.
G3197H.short: Melchi, an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy.

G3190.name: Melea
G3190.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G3190.brief: An ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy.
G3190.short: Melea, mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus.

G3104.name: Menna
G3104.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G3104.brief: An ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy.
G3104.short: Menna, mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus.

G3109.name: Macedonia
G3109.brief: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there
G3109.short: Macedonia, a region in northern Greece where Paul preached the gospel and established churches (<ref="Act.16.9-12; 20:1-3">Act.16.9-12; 20:1-3</ref>).
G3109.meaning: named for the Makedones people; often explained as “highlanders”

G3194.name: Malta
G3194.brief: An island where Paul was shipwrecked
G3194.short: Malta, an island in the Mediterranean Sea where Paul was shipwrecked on his journey to Rome (<ref="Act.28.1">Act.28.1</ref>).

G3134.name: Maranatha
G3134.brief: An Aramaic expression meaning "Our Lord, come!"
G3134.short: Maranatha is an Aramaic expression that means "Our Lord, come!" and is used in <ref="1Co.16.22">1Co.16.22</ref> as a prayer for the Lord's return.
